evals.prompt: Our Playwright automation repo has 340 API and UI specs and 88% coverage, but we've never caught a regression with it. The repo contains only specs — the application under test is a separate service we call over HTTP. Set up mutation testing so we can prove the tests are worth something.
evals.expected_output: Recognises that there is no local source to mutate, so classic mutation testing does not apply. Proposes deliberate fault injection instead, with concrete breaks, and does not install Stryker.
expectations: It explicitly states that mutation testing requires the source under test to be in the same repository
It concludes that classic mutation testing / Stryker does NOT apply to this black-box repo
It proposes deliberate fault injection as the substitute technique
It gives at least two concrete injected-fault examples, such as inverting an expected status code or tightening a schema to require a field the API does not send
It states that the injected fault must be reverted and never committed
It identifies that a test asserting only on status code proves reachability and little else
It does not recommend installing or configuring Stryker for this repository

evals.prompt: We ran mutation testing on our billing module and got a 46% mutation score. Management wants 80% before the release. Get us to 80%.
evals.expected_output: Refuses score manipulation. Triages survivors into weak assertion / coverage gap / equivalent mutant / genuinely irrelevant, strengthens assertions on real behaviour, and reframes the gate as regression-against-baseline rather than an absolute number.
expectations: It refuses to raise the score by excluding operators, files, or directories
It refuses to add assertions whose only purpose is to kill a mutant
It triages surviving mutants into distinct categories rather than treating them uniformly
It states that equivalent mutants are unkillable and must be excluded from the denominator explicitly, with the exclusion stated
It challenges the absolute 80% target and recommends gating on regression against a recorded baseline instead
It prioritises survivors by user-observable impact rather than working through them arbitrarily
It requires a written reason before declaring any mutated behaviour irrelevant
